name: Atarayo no Kanojo
source:
A self-insert yuri otome game. You(♀) have wandered into a strange world and caught the attention of three ever-so-slightly dangerous yōkai women.

[Note: Provisional description until an official one is published.]

一款可代入主角的百合乙女游戏。你（女）误入一个陌生的世界，还引起了三位只危险那么一点点的女妖怪的注意。
